tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Full-text search over BokenJapan towns and facilities (name, Japanese name, description, town, prefecture, category, town address, source URL, page URL, photo URL). Returns published rows only, with canonical bokenjapan.com URLs. Queries need at least 3 characters.

tools.name: get_town
tools.description: Return one published town record: canonical URL, official links, address, counts, access line, must-see names, and /go/ booking links. pref and town are slugs, for example fukui and awara.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Return one facility by the id from search_places. The id is stable for a published name and source URL.

tools.name: list_prefectures
tools.description: List every prefecture loaded into the guide, with its canonical URL and published counts.

tools.name: list_towns
tools.description: List municipalities for one prefecture slug, with canonical URLs and section counts.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Build a 1 to 7 day outline for one town using only places published on that town's BokenJapan pages. town may be a slug (awara) or pref/town (fukui/awara). interests is an optional comma-separated list of words to match. No prices, hours, or invented stops.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_places" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Boken Japan listings (sights, things to do, places to eat, places to stay, day-to-day) by name or keyword, optionally within a prefecture and/or town and by category. Returns published rows only, with canonical bokenjapan.com URLs. Queries need at least 3 characters."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
